ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Asymmetrical distribution; the left lobe contains a large central-to-distal white field fragmented by multiple vertical dark linear tracks. The right lobe contains a concentrated contiguous white field on the distal third with several small, dark focal spots. The central notch area and peduncle connection remain predominantly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 65-75 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the total lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with varying pixel-amplitude along the entire trailing edge; serrations become more jagged and pronounced toward the distal tips of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges sweeping symmetrically upward to narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-density clusters of raised white/tan circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Isolated white circular focal points are scattered across the mid-region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of distinct, roughly parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically across the large white field of the left lobe. Finer, unaligned white linear scratches are visible on the lower dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense biological encrustation on both lobe tips; a small, distinct indentation or notch is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately 60% of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive vertical banding pattern on the left fluke lobe resulting from the interaction of white pigmentation and dark linear abrasions.
